Wave 8 lands the four §D methodology/audit extensions consolidated from both S100 housekeeping ledgers (`session-100a-housekeeping.md §D` CF-W2-1 + CF-S101-HK-SUFFIX; `session-100b-housekeeping.md §D` CF-W4-2 + CF-W7-1) plus the EVOI-gated optional analytic gate `S101-ANALYTIC-HM-CERTIFICATION` (admitted at the S101 EVOI re-stamp as Tier-3 row #11d, `sessions/evoi-framework.md:69`; **drop FIRST under capacity pressure**). The wave is **MIXED-class as themed** and is therefore **sub-decomposed at plan-freeze** per `.claude/rules/wave-classification.md` §"NROY clause" into:

- **W8a (COMPUTE)** — audit-script extensions shipping `.py` self-tests (W8a-1, W8a-2) + the optional analytic certification gate (W8a-3).
- **W8b (METHODOLOGY)** — rule-file directive-only diffs + calibration-corpus rows (W8b-1, W8b-2, W8b-3), orchestrator-direct-write per `wave-classification.md` §"Dispatch consequences".

**Partition→plan gate-ID mapping (sub-decomposition disclosure)**: the partition manifest's item #1 `S101-HK-SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT` is itself a MIXED item (a `.py` audit sub-check — M2-failing for METHODOLOGY — bundled with a rule-file directive). Per the NROY clause ("Each sub-wave gets its own gate-ID and independent verdict line") it is **split into two gate-IDs**: `S101-HK-SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT-AUDIT` (W8a-1, COMPUTE) and `S101-HK-SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT-RULE` (W8b-1, METHODOLOGY). The split is the structurally forced choice (justification in the plan-freeze classification log below): the rule diff is orchestrator-direct-write under the METHODOLOGY dispatch path, while the audit sub-check is an agent-dispatchable `.py`; bundling them as one COMPUTE gate would route a `.claude/rules/` edit through a compute-mode subagent, inverting the wave-classification dispatch discipline. The parent ID `S101-HK-SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT` is RESERVED-UNEMITTED (no verdict line ever carries it). Neither child ID collides with any existing gate-ID (zero `S101-*` lines in `s100a_gate_verdicts.txt` + `s100b_gate_verdicts.txt`, verified at plan-freeze 2026-06-07).

**Upstream-entity disclosure (PRU Class-8 fix-now)**: `computations/_shared/_machinery_feasibility_audit.py` — the audit script that gates W8a-1/W8a-2 "extend" — **does NOT exist on disk at plan-freeze** (verified 2026-06-07; `Glob **/_machinery_feasibility*` returns nothing). ## Wave 8 Run-Order (MANDATORY serialization)

```
W8a-1  →  W8a-2  →  W8b-1  →  W8b-2  →  W8b-3  →  W8a-3 (optional; drop first)
```

Three independent reasons, all load-bearing:

1. **New-file single-writer**: W8a-1 creates `_machinery_feasibility_audit.py`; W8a-2 extends the same file. Concurrent dispatch = write collision on a brand-new module.
2. **Corpus single-writer**: W8a-2, W8b-1, W8b-2, W8b-3 each append ONE new section to `sessions/framework/registry/pru-class-corpus.md`. Raw `open("a")` appends are NOT atomic across processes on Windows (`gate-verdicts.md` §"Race-Safe Emission" rationale); per `epistemic-discipline.md` §"Registry-Write Hygiene" the appends use single-shot append-helpers AND are serialized by this run-order (one corpus writer at a time). Section allocation: next-free `## §N` at execution (≥ §21; file tail is §20 at plan-freeze, SHA-pinned below), scanning ALL header levels before allocation (Hygiene item 1); expected landing order §21 (W8a-2) → §22 (W8b-1) → §23 (W8b-2) → §24 (W8b-3); on runtime occupancy, reroute to next-free with FAIL-with-remediation disclosure in the verdict line (Hygiene item 3).
3. **Optional-last**: W8a-3 is the EVOI Tier-3 drop-first slot; running it last makes the capacity-pressure drop a clean truncation. **If dropped: NO verdict line is emitted** (pre-registered optional status — not a mechanical closure, not a FAIL); the wave synthesis records `DROPPED-OPTIONAL-PER-CAPACITY` and the EVOI row 11d remains live for S102 re-admission.

  audit sub-check, mechanically catches the W2-2 class of group-theoretically false
  "generically nonzero" matrix-element claims (synthetic positive flagged) without

method:

        discipline), :305 (Machinery-Feasibility Audit) as the governing rule anchors;
    (b) detect_selection_rule_preflight(plan_text) -> list[finding]:
        - Pattern set (pinned): regex over plan-block / substitution-chain text for
          (i) bra-ket nonzero claims between named SU(3) sectors:
              r"<\s*(?:psi_?)?\(?(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\)?\s*\|(.+?)\|\s*(?:psi_?)?\(?(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\)?\s*>\s*(?:!=|\\neq|≠)\s*0"
              (plus the unicode bra-ket variants ⟨…⟩ of the same form);
          (ii) prose-form claims: r"(?i)\b(generically\s+non-?zero|non-?zero\s+matrix\s+element|connect(?:s|ing)\s+.{0,40}sectors)\b"
              within 400 chars of two named (p,q) sector labels.
        - For each match: extract (p1,q1), (p2,q2); compute triality t(p,q) = (p - q) mod 3;
          determine the operator's center character t_O from the matched operator text:
          declared-irrep forms "in (a,b)" -> t_O = (a - b) mod 3; squared-modulus forms
          |f|^2 / f*conj(f) / mod-squared -> t_O = 0 ALWAYS; undeclared -> t_O = UNDECLARED.
        - Admissibility predicate (NECESSARY condition only — a passed screen does NOT
          certify nonzero): t(p1,q1) == (t(p2,q2) + t_O) mod 3.
        - Finding emission: predicate FALSE -> flag SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT-VIOLATION,
          severity S2 (advisory, rule status SUGGESTION K=1; escalates to S1 on the rule's
          K=3 MANDATORY promotion — severity ladder pinned in the module, keyed on the rule
          status string the module reads from its own docstring constant, NOT auto-promoted);
          t_O == UNDECLARED on a nonzero claim -> flag SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT-UNDECLARED-
          OPERATOR-CHARACTER, severity S2 (the claim is unscreenable as written).
    (c) --self-test: runs the two pinned fixtures (below) + asserts the expected flag/no-flag
        behavior; exits 0 iff the self-test assertions hold (exit codes per math-scripts.md
        §Exit Codes: nonzero = script breakage only).
    Then the session driver computations/session-101/s101_w8a1_selection_rule_preflight_test.py:
    imports the new module, executes --self-test programmatically, re-derives the W2-2
    calibration arithmetic (mod-3 table below) as an in-driver cross-check against the pinned
    companion row at s100a_gate_verdicts.txt:40, saves the npz, computes dual-SHA from the
    input-pin map via closure_hash() per .claude/templates/script-template.py, prints the
    verdict payload (print_verdict_payload); the agent then calls emit_verdict (session 101).
  producing_script: "computations/session-101/s101_w8a1_selection_rule_preflight_test.py"

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (the calibration claim is a zero/sign claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the W2-2 pre-registered element <psi_(1,0)| |s(h)|^2 |psi_(1,1)> is 0 EXACTLY
            (center-Z3/triality selection), so the plan-w2 'generically nonzero' chain was
            group-theoretically inadmissible at plan-freeze"
    Definition 1: triality t(p,q) := (p - q) mod 3 — the SU(3) center-Z3 character of irrep
                  (p,q): psi_(p,q)(z g) = omega^{t(p,q)} psi_(p,q)(g), z = omega*I,
                  omega = e^{2 pi i/3}.   [standard SU(3) representation theory; the same
                  Z3 grading underlying the PROVEN Peter-Weyl block structure of D_K]
    Definition 2: center-character selection rule — <psi_a| O |psi_b> != 0 REQUIRES the
                  trivial rep to occur in (a)* (x) (O) (x) (b); restricted to the center this
                  reads omega^{-t(a)} omega^{t(O)} omega^{t(b)} = 1, i.e.
                  t(a) == t(b) + t(O) (mod 3).   [Schur; NECESSARY condition only — the
                  full CG decomposition can vanish even when the center check passes]
    Definition 3: |s(h)|^2 = s(h) * conj(s(h)); s in (2,0) => t(s) = 2; conj(s) in (0,2)
                  => t = (0-2) mod 3 = 1; t(|s|^2) = (2+1) mod 3 = 0.   [squared moduli are
                  ALWAYS center-character 0 — center-invariant by construction]
    Substitute:   a = (1,0), b = (1,1), O = |s(h)|^2:
                  require t(1,0) == t(1,1) + t(|s|^2) (mod 3)
                  i.e.    1      ==   0    +    0      (mod 3).
    Simplify:     1 == 0 (mod 3) is FALSE.
    Direction:    the center average annihilates the element: <(1,0)| |s(h)|^2 |(1,1)> = 0
                  EXACTLY. The cited connecting property ("C^2 in su(3) weight connecting
                  triality-adjacent sectors") belongs to s(h) itself (t = 2 == -1 mod 3, which
                  CAN connect t-adjacent sectors: t(1,1) = 0 == t(1,0) + t(s) = 1 + 2 mod 3),
                  NOT to |s(h)|^2.
    Conclusion:   a two-line mod-3 pre-flight catches this claim class at plan-freeze; the
                  W2-2 instance (caught in-gate, honestly disclosed at
                  s100a_gate_verdicts.txt:40, audit 871573da729c5972...) is the calibration.

         6284d0d3ac7a85c8174f26c8d1ae8561f4ff89945ae6d86cffb4a8b8ff8fb27e); finding routes
         the plan author to the Sage-MCP sage_simplify factorization check per the rule's
         §Plan-freeze pre-flight items 1-4 (the detector is the SCREEN; the factorization
         check is the disambiguator — the detector proves nothing by itself).
    (S2) RATIO-OF-PIPELINES (NEW): regex for gated quantities of the form
         |log10(X_em/X_ref)| or X_A/X_B over two named pipelines —
         r"log_?10\s*\(\s*\w+_(?:em|A|1)\s*/\s*\w+_(?:ref|B|2)\s*\)" + generic

         (pre-registered HERE: the NEW classes ship at S2 — the rule's S1 MANDATORY text

    --self-test extension: FOUR fixtures — synthetic positive per class (S1, S2, S3) + ONE
    synthetic negative (a two-pipeline ratio whose legs scale by DIFFERENT parameters — no

    CORPUS APPEND (in-gate deliverable, single-shot append-helper per epistemic-discipline.md
    §Registry-Write Hygiene): ONE new section in sessions/framework/registry/pru-class-corpus.md
    (next-free §N >= 21; expected §21 under the wave run-order) titled "Multiplicative-
    normalization cancellation — laboratory-IN pipeline-parameter signature corpus

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (both calibration claims are exact-cancellation/sign claims)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim 1 (RATIO-OF-PIPELINES calibration; binding text transcribed from
             session-100b-w7-workingpaper.md:262 / housekeeping-100b §D CF-W7-1):
      "max_z |log10(n_ACH_em/n_ACH_ref)| is EXACTLY 0 by G-cancellation under the
       borrowed-(H_0, Omega, sigma_8) baseline"
      Definition 1: M_ACH ~ 1/(G*H)        [ACH mass scale; pipeline scaling, binding CF text]
      Definition 2: rho_m,0 ~ 1/G          [matter density under the borrowed baseline]
      Definition 3: n_ACH(> T_vir) = count of objects above a FIXED T_vir threshold, built
                    from (M_ACH, rho_m,0, H); the T_vir threshold criterion is G-free
                    [binding CF text]
      Substitute:   n_ACH_em/n_ACH_ref — numerator and denominator pipelines carry the SAME
                    G-scalings (Definitions 1-2 apply to both legs; only the em/ref H(t)
                    differs); the selection criterion contributes no G.
      Simplify:     every G-factor appears identically in both legs -> G cancels in the ratio.
      Direction:    max_z |log10(n_ACH_em/n_ACH_ref)| == 0 IDENTICALLY in the pure shared-G
                    channel — a STRUCTURAL IDENTITY of the pipeline pair, not an empirical
                    constraint on the substrate. A plan-freeze detector keying only on
                    log-derivative signatures cannot see this: the gated quantity is a
                    log-RATIO-of-pipelines, not a log-derivative.
      Conclusion:   signature class S2 (RATIO-OF-PIPELINES) is required; calibration row 1.
    Claim 2 (VARIANCE-FUNCTIONAL calibration; binding text from the same CF):
      "flat multiplicative capture S cancels exactly in the fractional count variance"
      Definition 1: sigma_CV(N) := Std(N)/Mean(N)   [fractional count variance / coefficient
                    of variation over the count vector N]
      Definition 2: flat capture: N -> S*N with S a single scalar (z-independent completeness)
      Substitute:   sigma_CV(S*N) = Std(S*N)/Mean(S*N) = (S*Std(N))/(S*Mean(N))
      Simplify:     = Std(N)/Mean(N) = sigma_CV(N).
      Direction:    sigma_CV is INVARIANT under flat S — the gated variance criterion carries
                    zero sensitivity to the capture normalization; structural identity.
      Conclusion:   signature class S3 (VARIANCE-FUNCTIONAL) is required; calibration row 2.
    Axis claim: "the cancelling factors (G, S) are laboratory-IN pipeline parameters — a

      Substitute: G and S enter through the LABORATORY-IN reduction pipeline (emergent-
                  Friedmann halo counting; survey capture), not through the substrate
                  spectral support of any D_K functional.
      Direction:  distinct axis by inspection of where the factor enters the functional;
                  hence corpus rows document a NEW cancelling_axis value (LAB-IN-PIPELINE)
                  WITHOUT advancing the spectral-support K-counter (binding CF: "corpus
                  append only, no K-advancement decision").

        OPERATOR-MISMATCH-DETECTED routing this directive extends), a new #### sub-section
        carrying EXACTLY the BINDING text below (this plan is the freeze of that text;
        execution transcribes, never re-derives — cross-wave pin 5):
        ---- BINDING RULE TEXT (start) ----
        #### Selection-rule pre-flight for pre-registered nonzero matrix elements

        **Status**: SUGGESTION (K=1). Promotes to MANDATORY at K=3 per
        `feedback_rules-compensate-missing-structure.md`.

        Any plan-block substitution chain claiming a matrix element `<psi_a| O |psi_b>`
        between named irrep sectors is "generically nonzero" (or asserting `!= 0` /
        "connects sectors") MUST carry a center-character / triality CG-admissibility check
        at plan-freeze:

        1. **State the center characters** — `t(a)`, `t(b)`, and the operator's center
           character `t(O)`. For SU(3): `t(p,q) = (p - q) mod 3`; a squared modulus `|f|^2`
           is ALWAYS center-character 0, regardless of the irrep content of `f`.
        2. **Verify admissibility** — `t(a) == t(b) + t(O) (mod 3)` (general form: the
           trivial rep must occur in `a* (x) O (x) b`). The check is a NECESSARY condition
           only: a passed check does NOT certify the element nonzero; a failed check proves
           it 0 EXACTLY.
        3. **Mismatch routing** — a failed check means the "generically nonzero" claim is
           group-theoretically inadmissible; the plan-block MUST be revised at plan-freeze
           per the OPERATOR-MISMATCH-DETECTED routing of §"Plan-author discipline at
           plan-freeze" item 4 (revise the formula, re-anchor to the admissible operator, or
           declare the derived form with its derivation cited).

        Audit: `computations/_shared/_machinery_feasibility_audit.py::detect_selection_rule_preflight`
        (S2 advisory under SUGGESTION; S1 on MANDATORY promotion). Calibration corpus:
        `sessions/framework/registry/pru-class-corpus.md` (selection-rule pre-flight section).
        ---- BINDING RULE TEXT (end) ----
    (2) CORPUS APPEND (single-shot append-helper; serialized by wave run-order — this gate
        is the SECOND corpus writer, after W8a-2): new section at next-free ## §N (expected
        §22) in sessions/framework/registry/pru-class-corpus.md, titled "Selection-rule
        pre-flight (math-scripts.md §Double-Check Logic Before Compute sub-clause) —
        calibration corpus", carrying the K=1 instance: the S100a plan-w2 §W2-2 chain
        asserted <psi_(1,0)| |s(h)|^2 |psi_(1,1)> != 0 via "C^2 in su(3) weight connecting
        triality-adjacent sectors" — group-theoretically FALSE (|s(h)|^2 is triality-0;
        center-Z3 gives 0 EXACTLY; the cited connecting property belongs to s(h) in (2,0),
        not |s(h)|^2); caught in-gate and honestly disclosed (canonical line
        s100a_gate_verdicts.txt:36, audit
        871573da729c59722ee060b37c70741f8d917e2560fe11ef74910f6be3bd2925; selection-rule
        companion row :40); full mod-3 arithmetic table; K-counter at K=1 (advances on
        distinct inadmissible-claim catches at plan-freeze, not on re-citations of W2-2).
    (3) VERIFICATION RUN: computations/session-101/s101_w8b_methodology_verify.py
        --gate S101-HK-SELECTION-RULE-PREFLIGHT-RULE — greps the landed rule sub-section
        (all must_contain markers below) + the corpus section; computes the METHODOLOGY-class

  type: "conjunction of two analytic-certification clauses (characterization class; no numerical threshold)"
  form: >
    PASS iff [ Leg 1 CERTIFIED: closed-form Weyl law with d = 8 exact, symbolic check
    residual = 0, HM Def-2.3 hypothesis discharged on the untruncated triple ] AND
    [ Leg 2 CERTIFIED: explicit non-scalar G_t-fixed momentum functions exhibited with
    symbolic Poisson-commutation verified, HM Def-6.10 ergodicity refuted ] AND
    [ Leg 3: composition through the extracted Thm 6.11 + Zel96 anchors stated with no
    unproven dynamical input remaining ].
    INFO iff [ Leg 1 CERTIFIED but Leg 2 requires an unproven dynamical input (e.g., a
    completeness/regularity property of the geodesic flow not derivable from the Noether
    momenta alone) ] OR [ extraction-limited: both PDF routes fail — sub-path (c) ].
    FAIL iff [ either leg is REFUTED — e.g., the geodesic flow proves ergodic, contradicting
    the conserved momenta ]. A FAIL contradicts PROVEN structure ([iK_7, D_K] = 0; right-
    isometry of the Jensen metric) — escalation protocol: verify the derivation first; a
    surviving FAIL routes to S102 priority adjudication (Q1 workshop class).

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary — N/A (characterization class)
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "N/A — analytic-certification conjunction; the only numbers are exact (d = 8; residual = 0 symbolic) (S95 non-compute note)"
  direction: "="

    at all tau (PROVEN); D_K Peter-Weyl block-diagonality (PROVEN, off-diag < 8.4e-15 —
    quantum shadow of the right-isometry Leg 2 uses classically).

NO Mellin-residue evaluation is planned, so the Mellin pole-set labeling does not bind; IF the executor reformulates Leg 1 through zeta_{D}(s) poles, the citation MUST carry poleconv-{A-double|B-single} + (pole_in_s, curvature_grade_n) per regulator-pin-discipline.md §Mellin Pole-Set Labeling — pre-registered conditional pin"

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (directional pre-registration: NON-ergodic, n_vacuum > 1)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim A: "the untruncated Weyl dimension is d = 8 exactly (Leg 1 target)"
      Definition 1: HM Def 2.3 — Weyl law Tr(e^{-t D^2}) ~ C t^{-d/2} as t -> 0 on the
                    untruncated triple.   [extracted from the pinned PDF at execution]
      Definition 2: heat-kernel leading asymptotics on a closed Riemannian n-manifold:
                    Tr(e^{-t Delta}) ~ Vol/(4 pi t)^{n/2}; for the Dirac-type D on the
                    SU(3) group manifold with Jensen metric, the leading power is set by
                    n = dim SU(3) = 8 (the smooth closed-form metric exists at every tau:
                    g1/g2 = e^{-2 tau}, PROVEN).
      Substitute:   t^{-n/2} = t^{-8/2} = t^{-4} => d = 8.
      Cross-anchor: S52 canonical lim_{sigma->0} d_s = 8 (same functional, sigma -> 0
                    scale-type — the fair-comparison pair is fixed: both sides are the
                    t -> 0 asymptotic of the SAME heat trace on the UNTRUNCATED object,
                    per phononic-framing §Same-functional-different-scale).
      Direction:    d = 8 exact; the HM Def-2.3 hypothesis is DISCHARGED analytically —
                    the L12 truncation's d_fit_global = 4.11 (W4-1) was a truncation
                    artifact of the missing UV tower, not a property of the fabric.
    Claim B: "the geodesic flow is classically NON-ergodic (Leg 2 target)"
      Definition 1: HM Def 6.10 — classically ergodic iff the only G_t-fixed points in
                    L^2(S*A) are scalars.   [extracted at execution]
      Definition 2: the Jensen metric retains a right-isometry subgroup containing U(2)
                    and the K_7 flow (the deformation breaks SU(3)_R to this residual;
                    PROVEN quantum shadow: [iK_7, D_K] = 0 at ALL tau).
      Definition 3: Noether — for each Killing field X, the momentum function
                    P_X(xi) = <xi, X(pi(xi))> on S*A is conserved by the geodesic flow:
                    {H, P_X} = 0.
      Substitute:   take X in u(2) + R*K_7 (dim >= 5): P_X is G_t-fixed; P_X is non-constant
                    on S*A (X is a non-vanishing Killing field on a group manifold; its
                    momentum separates covectors).
      Simplify:     L^2(S*A)^{G_t} contains the non-scalar functions {P_X} (and all their
                    bounded functions) => the only-scalars condition FAILS.
      Direction:    classically NON-ergodic. PASS direction = NON-ergodic (matches the
                    fabric-scale integrability corroboration of W4-1 at the truncated
                    level; this gate upgrades it to criterion level on the untruncated
                    object).
    Claim C: "therefore the vacuum state is NON-unique (Leg 3 composition)"
      Definition 1: HM Thm 6.11 + the unique-vacuum remark + Zel96 rank-1 vacuum remark:
                    under the Weyl law (Leg 1), classical ergodicity <=> QE diagonal
                    convergence <=> unique vacuum of the C*-dynamical system.
                    [extracted at execution]
      Substitute:   Leg 1 holds (hypothesis discharged) AND Leg 2 refutes ergodicity.
      Direction:    contrapositive composition => vacuum NON-unique — certified at theorem
                    level, with HM Example 6.12.2 as the continuum-level ancestor.
      Conclusion:   the fabric's vacuum structure IS non-unique by its own conserved
                    momenta; registry-eligible §VII vacuum-sector candidate (S102+, full
                    bridge-anatomy discipline; NOT registered by this gate).

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  Both legs certified analytically: the framework's first certified NCG-ergodicity-criterion
  theorem — the untruncated Jensen-SU(3) triple satisfies the HM Weyl hypothesis (d = 8
  exact) and refutes classical ergodicity by its own conserved right-U(2)/K_7 momenta, so
  the vacuum state of the fabric's C*-dynamical system is certifiably NON-unique.
  Registry-eligible §VII vacuum-sector candidate at S102+ under full bridge-anatomy
  discipline. Upgrades W4-1's truncation-level Track-B diagnostics to criterion level and
  retroactively explains the W4-1 INFO (the Weyl failure was a truncation artifact).
FAIL_meaning: >
  A leg is REFUTED — structurally near-impossible (would contradict PROVEN [iK_7, D_K] = 0
  / the right-isometry of the Jensen closed forms). Escalation pre-registered: verify the
  derivation and the metric closed forms first; a surviving FAIL is an S102 priority Q1
  adjudication and re-opens the fabric-scale integrability narration.
INFO_meaning: >
  Sub-paths: (a) Weyl leg certified, ergodicity leg needs an unproven dynamical input — the
  gap is named precisely and becomes a 4-field S102 carry-forward; (c) extraction-limited
  (both PDF routes fail; criterion pin unavailable, NEVER filled from training knowledge).
  INFO carries no registry action; the per-leg ledger in the npz is the diagnostic.

    - "computations/session-101/s101_w8a3_analytic_hm_certification.py"
    - "computations/session-101/s101_w8a3_analytic_hm_certification.npz"
    - "sessions/session-101/session-101-w8-workingpaper.md §W8a-3 (section only; carries the full theorem text)"
  estimated_time: "4-6 hours, 1 agent (analytic derivation + symbolic checks + anchor extraction); ~1 gate per the binding spec"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The substrate IS the untruncated spectral triple (A_K, H_K, D_K(tau)); its
  vacuum-state structure is an INTRINSIC functional of the fabric's own symmetry content —
  the fabric's vacuum structure IS non-unique by its own conserved momenta. The arrow runs:
  Jensen closed-form metric (the fabric's intrinsic deformation, g1/g2 = e^{-2 tau}) ->
  residual right-U(2)/K_7 isometry -> conserved Noether momenta on S*A (classical) AND
  [iK_7, D_K] = 0 (quantum shadow, PROVEN) -> non-scalar G_t-fixed functions -> classical
  non-ergodicity (HM Def 6.10) -> vacuum-state NON-uniqueness of the emergent C*-dynamical
  system (HM Thm 6.11 + Zel96) -> the fabric-scale integrability the GGE relic's diabatic
  transit-freeze reads out (R_therm = 5251.82, S_ent = 0, S95-certified). The HM paper is

  holds at ALL tau — a moduli-uniform family of Level-1 statements, with the Level-2
